summary: 7 doubts, none blocking. D1 FIXED (shared read falls back to central actions.json; reset clears it). D6 FIXED (case-fold only on win32/darwin). D2 documented (migrate/reset delete repo files; button tooltip + guide note). D3 rebutted/documented (unattributable cwd keeps old paste location; stated limit). D4 known trade-off (central path outside cwd may prompt). D5 cosmetic. D7 documented (central folder not removed on project delete).

doubts.failing_scenario: Custom central actions.json disappears after ticking shared; no way back via migrate.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Deleting webui files from the repo is safe
doubts.failing_scenario: A git-tracked actions.json shows up as a deletion after Move/Reset.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: A default project never receives pastes in the repo
doubts.failing_scenario: Task whose cwd is outside every registered project (sibling worktree) pastes into cwd.
Agent may prompt/refuse for an image outside its working dir.
Two server processes can report a false conflict.
Case-sensitive FS treats /work/App and /work/app as one root.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Deleting a project leaves nothing behind
doubts.failing_scenario: Central project folder is never removed.
